name: agent-nocturne
description: A nocturne for your coding agent, played on the MacBook keyboard backlight.
author: changfenhuang (taekchef)

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p native/build && clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation native/agent-light-backlight.m -o native/build/agent-light-backlight
scripts.check: node --check bin/*.mjs && node --check scripts/*.mjs && node --check site/app.js && node --check src/*.mjs && node --check src/backends/*.mjs && node --check adapters/claude-code/scripts/*.mjs && node --check adapters/codex/scripts/*.mjs
